words.en: I/he/she had (imperfect subjunctive of haber; helper for past-unreal si)
words.note: Si no hubiera llegado aquella noche. Always + participle.

example.es: Si hubiera llegado el tren, todo habría cambiado.
example.en: If the train had arrived, everything would have changed.
